author: DamiLee
description:
I'd seen Choi Hung Estate all over Instagram, so I expected it to feel cramped. It's about 7,400 flats, after all. But it doesn't. The architects mixed eight 20-storey blocks with three 7-storey ones, so you never feel boxed in.

Now it's coming down. From 2028, the estate will be rebuilt in three phases over about 20 years. A lot of the residents are elderly, and some will spend the rest of their lives next to a construction site. Hong Kong protects fewer than 150 buildings by law. Choi Hung isn't one of them.

What would you do if you'd lived in Choi Hung for 50 years?

title: Hong Kong’s Rainbow Estate is Coming Down
